summary.name: Venom Car AI
summary.one_liner: A paid web tool that turns one car photo into a roughly 15-second vertical MP4 of black goo crawling a garage, grabbing the badge, and reassembling the car.
use_cases: Making a Venom-style TikTok or Reels clip of your own car
Swapping a club crest or shop logo into the badge-grab effect
Creating a short vertical car reveal video from one photo
Producing a car social media post without video editing skills
summary.what_it_does: Users upload one clear whole-car photo, optionally with a logo or emblem that the goo grabs instead of the factory badge. They choose 9:16, 3:4, 16:9 or 1:1 and generate a locked garage-build template of about 15 seconds at 720p, with AI ambient audio. The page says the car in the output keeps the photo's paint, wheels and lights. There is no prompt or timeline editing, and renders carry no watermark. Credits are held on generation and refunded automatically if a render fails.
notable: One car photo in, locked ~15s goo garage-build MP4 out, with no prompt or editing
Optional logo upload swaps the badge the goo grabs
Automatic credit refund on failed renders
caveats: Not free: packs start at $8.88 one-time (500 credits per 720p render), paid via Stripe checkout
Browser only, no native app; needs rights to the car photo
Renders are 720p only; download links reportedly expire after about 24 hours
